lines.speaker: FASSBENDER
lines.text: Because the-the reason I’m askin’ that is if, if Steven were to try and get someone in, into a position he has ultimately got her in, I don’t think she’s gonna go along with the program. lines.text: OK. But you don’t recall seeing any of that?

lines.text: Is everything at this point in time, you told us the truth as you know it?

lines.speaker: WIEGERT
lines.text: What is, something real quick. Was she, she was a kinda of a fighter, huh? She would fight a little bit? Anything you wanna say ta Teresa or her family right now since you’re being taped?

lines.text: Mark mentioned talkin’ to your mom about this and being truthful with her now. OK? If you’re truly sorry to the Halbachs, you’ll be, you’ll tell your mother the truth about this. OK?
